ADC_APEX_ACTIONS

Table to store APEX actions to be maintained by ADC.

Columns
caa_id

Technical key, PK

caa_crg_id

Part of Unique, Reference to ADC_RULE_GROUP

caa_caat_id

Type of the action. Reference to ADC_APEX_ACTION_TYPES

caa_name

Part of Unique, a unique name for the action within that ADC rule group

caa_pti_id

Display name of the action. Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM

caa_pmg_name

Message group, fixed to value ADC

caa_confirm_message_name

Optional PIT message for confirmation

caa_confirm_type

Message type of the confirmation message

caa_icon

Icon for the action

caa_icon_type

Icon type, defaults to Font APEX

caa_shortcut

Keyboard shortcut to invoke the action

caa_initially_disabled

Flag to indicate whether this action is initially disabled

caa_initially_hidden

Flag to indicate whether this action is initially hidden

caa_href

URL for navigation actions

caa_action

JavaScript callback definition for the action

caa_on_label

Label when a toggle action is true

caa_off_label

Label when a toggle action is false

caa_get

Getter callback for toggle and radio group actions

caa_set

Setter callback for toggle and radio group actions

caa_choices

SQL statement to create radio group choices

caa_label_classes

Classes to add to all radio labels

caa_label_start_classes

Classes to add to the first radio label

caa_label_end_classes

Classes to add to the last radio label

caa_item_wrap_class

Classes to add to the wrapper element

References
caa_crg_id

references ADC_RULE_GROUPS (crg_id)

caa_caat_id

references ADC_APEX_ACTION_TYPES (caat_id) caa_pti_id, caa_pmg_name -> PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM (pti_uid, pti_upmg)
